name: NestJS
runtime: Node.js 26.13.1 LTS, NODE_ENV=production, compiled with nest build (tsc)
database_layer: TypeORM 1.1 via @nestjs/typeorm with pg, 8 connections per process (16 in total)
logging: none per request (Nest has no request logger); start-up log per process

phase2.validation: ParseIntPipe for the id; ValidationPipe with class-validator DTOs for the query, the JSON body and the form: 400

session.mechanism: @nestjs/authentication 0.1 SessionCookieProvider, server-side sessions in a TypeORM SessionStore (hand-written)

notes: Nest's documentation recommends the NodeAdapter since v12.3; Nest still uses Express when no adapter is passed.
